triggers.name: Passive
triggers.summary: Always on. Folded into your stats once at round start, so it costs nothing per tick.

triggers.name: OnHitPlayer
triggers.summary: One of your projectiles hit somebody.

triggers.name: OnBlock
triggers.summary: You pressed block, whether or not anything was deflected.

triggers.name: OnHitTerrain
triggers.summary: One of your projectiles hit the board rather than a piece. Carries the place it landed, which is the only thing this trigger is for.

triggers.name: OnBlink
triggers.summary: You started a blink. Carries where you left from, not where you arrive.

actions.name: StatMod
actions.label: Change a stat
actions.summary: Modifies one stat. The only action that reads the stat and operation fields.
actions.valueMeans: The amount, meaning whatever the operation makes it mean.

actions.name: Heal
actions.label: Heal
actions.summary: Restores health immediately.

actions.name: ReloadNow
actions.label: Reload now
actions.summary: Refills the magazine on the spot.

actions.name: RefreshBlock
actions.label: Refresh block
actions.summary: Clears the block cooldown so it can be used again straight away.

actions.name: PushNearby
actions.label: Push nearby
actions.summary: Shoves everyone within a radius away from you.

actions.name: PullNearby
actions.label: Pull nearby
actions.summary: Drags everyone within a radius toward you.

actions.name: DamageNearby
actions.label: Damage nearby
actions.summary: Hurts everyone within a radius.

actions.name: SlowNearby
actions.label: Slow nearby
actions.summary: Slows everyone within a radius.
actions.value3Means: Duration, in seconds. Zero means one second, which is what this did before an area slow could say how long it lasted.

actions.name: SpawnRing
actions.label: Spawn a ring
actions.summary: Fires projectiles outward in every direction at once.

actions.name: Blink
actions.label: Blink
actions.summary: Moves you instantly in the direction you are aiming.

actions.name: SlowTarget
actions.label: Slow the target
actions.summary: Slows whoever was hit.

actions.name: StunTarget
actions.label: Stun the target
actions.summary: Takes everything away from whoever was hit, briefly.

actions.name: PoisonTarget
actions.label: Poison the target
actions.summary: Damage that arrives after the hit does.

actions.name: HasteSelf
actions.label: Haste yourself
actions.summary: Temporary movement speed for you.

actions.name: ShieldSelf
actions.label: Shield yourself
actions.summary: Temporary extra health that expires.

actions.name: CostHealth
actions.label: Cost health
actions.summary: Takes health off you. For cards that charge you to use them.

actions.name: DamageSource
actions.label: Damage the source
actions.summary: Hurts whoever the moment was about, at any range - the shooter who hit you, not whoever happens to be standing nearby. Thorns.

actions.name: PushSource
actions.label: Push the source
actions.summary: Shoves whoever the moment was about directly away from you, at any range.

actions.name: GrowPlank
actions.label: Grow a plank
actions.summary: A shot that lands leaves a splinter, and the splinter grows into a plank of cover where it hit. It stands for the round and everything in the world can hit it. Capped per round.

actions.name: LeaveDecoy
actions.label: Leave a decoy
actions.summary: The body you blinked out of stays standing. Shot, it comes apart with a full seven pieces of shrapnel, owned by you. One at a time.
actions.valueMeans: How long it stands, in seconds.

actions.name: Rot
actions.label: Rot
actions.summary: The pieces of anyone you kill carry your poison into whoever they hit, and you move faster while they are still in the air.
actions.value2Means: How long that poison lasts, in seconds.
actions.value3Means: Move speed multiplier while the pieces fly.

actions.name: ReleaseMutation
actions.label: Release a mutation
actions.summary: Puts a named mutation on the whole board for the next round - everyone, the holder included. It fires once, when the card is taken, and never again: it is about acquiring the card rather than about a moment in a round, so its trigger is ignored.
actions.valueMeans: Which mutation, as its number in the mutation list.

actions.name: HomeInFlight
actions.label: Turn your shots in flight
actions.summary: Every shot of yours still in the air turns toward the nearest living player. Splinters are left alone - they belong to a corpse, not a gun.
actions.valueMeans: The speed multiplier applied as they turn.

actions.name: SplitOnTerrain
actions.label: Break on the board
actions.summary: A shot that hits terrain comes apart into fragments thrown outward from the place it stopped, rather than around you.
actions.value3Means: Their share of your damage, each.

actions.name: SlowProjectiles
actions.label: Slow the shots near you
actions.summary: Every projectile near you that is not yours has its velocity scaled down. It acts on the shots themselves, so nothing about the shooter changes.
actions.valueMeans: The multiplier applied to their velocity.

actions.name: SwapWithTarget
actions.label: Change places
actions.summary: You and whoever the moment was about swap positions, if the two of you are at least so far apart. Velocities stay with their owners.
actions.valueMeans: The least distance it will fire at, in units.

actions.name: MomentumDamage
actions.label: Damage for your speed
actions.summary: Adds damage for the speed you were carrying when the hit landed. The only thing in the vocabulary that reads the holder's own velocity.
actions.valueMeans: Damage per unit of your speed.

actions.name: BlastAt
actions.label: Detonate at a place
actions.summary: Pushes and hurts everyone near a place rather than near you, falling off toward the rim. On a blink, that place is where you left.

actions.name: PinTarget
actions.label: Pin down
actions.summary: Takes the target's velocity away outright and slows them on top of it - the difference between somebody being slow and somebody being dropped.
actions.value2Means: How long the slow lasts, in seconds.

actions.name: BorrowHealth
actions.label: Borrow health
actions.summary: Returns health now and takes exactly that much back, as poison on you, over the next few seconds. Net zero; what it buys is the ordering.
actions.value2Means: Seconds it is paid back over.

actions.name: Overheal
actions.label: Heal and spill
actions.summary: Heals, and whatever will not fit becomes shield instead of being thrown away. A kill taken at full health is worth the most.
actions.value2Means: How long the spilled shield lasts, in seconds.

actions.name: TurnProjectiles
actions.label: Turn the volley
actions.summary: Every projectile near you that is not yours reverses and becomes yours - a whole volley, at range, rather than the one shot a block catches.
actions.valueMeans: The speed multiplier as it comes back.

actions.name: StunNearby
actions.label: Stun near a place
actions.summary: Stops everyone standing near a place. On a blink, that place is where you left, so it needs only that they were near you a moment ago.

actions.name: DrainSource
actions.label: Take their next shot
actions.summary: Whoever the moment was about loses their magazine, and their reload takes at least this long. The only action that reaches into another player's gun.
actions.valueMeans: The least their reload will take, in seconds.

cards.name: Bullet Time
cards.description: Recompiled: bullets, faster.

cards.name: Buckshot
cards.description: Split into three. Each one carries less.

cards.name: Bouncy
cards.description: Told to bounce off the board twice before it lets them go.

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.description: Hits far harder. Kicks the piece holding it, too.

cards.name: Feather
cards.description: Lightened. Easier to steer once its feet leave the board.

cards.name: Double Jump
cards.description: One more push allowed before the board takes it back.

cards.name: Dasher
cards.description: One more dash spliced in, and the wait between them cut.

cards.name: Parry
cards.description: The block resets twice as fast, and answers twice as hard.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.description: A third of what it deals returns to the piece that dealt it.

cards.name: Glass
cards.description: Hits far harder. Takes far more, the same edit both ways.

cards.name: Grenadier
cards.description: Bullets are told to arc, and to finish loudly.

cards.name: Barrage
cards.description: Many bullets, spliced in, each one thinned to make room.

cards.name: Combine
cards.description: Halved the magazine. Doubled what each round carries.

cards.name: Fastball
cards.description: Bullets rewritten fast. The gun that throws them, not.

cards.name: Spray
cards.description: Fired as fast as the edit allows. Aimed at nothing in particular.

cards.name: Careful Planning
cards.description: One shot. Weighed, slowed, and meant.

cards.name: Big Bullet
cards.description: Bullets grown large. Harder for a piece to be missed by.

cards.name: Quick Reload
cards.description: The wait between magazines, cut down.

cards.name: Mayhem
cards.description: Bullets told to keep bouncing until the board is done with them.

cards.name: Thruster
cards.description: A hit does not end. It keeps shoving, for as long as it clings.

cards.name: Sniper
cards.description: One shot, slow to arrive, that does not waver on the way.

cards.name: Flak
cards.description: Many weak shots, spliced in, that fall apart fast.

cards.name: Heavy Rounds
cards.description: Bullets grown heavy. Slower to arrive, harder to stand in front of.

cards.name: Homewrecker
cards.description: Every shot is edited to finish loudly, including on the piece that fired it.

cards.name: Yeeeuge
cards.description: More wood to work with. More wood to be hit.

cards.name: Tank
cards.description: Built heavier. Everything about it moves slower for it, including the gun.

cards.name: Glass Cannon
cards.description: Rewritten to hit like the board itself, and just as thin.

cards.name: Regrowth
cards.description: The wood is told to knit itself back, slowly, on its own.

cards.name: Sprinter
cards.description: Faster with feet on the board. Slower once they leave it.

cards.name: Anvil
cards.description: Falls like one, and takes the landing like one.

cards.name: Slipstream
cards.description: Every shot shoves this piece along with it. Ride the recoil.

cards.name: Scavenger
cards.description: A hit lands, and the gun is refilled without being asked.

cards.name: Taste Of Blood
cards.description: The first cut this piece draws makes it faster, briefly.

cards.name: Brawler
cards.description: A hit lands, and extra wood grows in on the spot, briefly.

cards.name: Refresh
cards.description: Every hit dealt resets the block, on the house.

cards.name: Venom
cards.description: Bullets carry rot now. It keeps working after they land.

cards.name: Cold Bullets
cards.description: Whatever a bullet touches, it slows down.

cards.name: Dazzle
cards.description: A hit locks the joints, briefly.

cards.name: Executioner
cards.description: Stopping a piece pays. So does simply standing.

cards.name: Blight
cards.description: Slower rot, and more of it. What it touches keeps giving the wound back.

cards.name: Concussion
cards.description: A clean block rings through whatever threw the shot. It stops moving for a moment.

cards.name: Siphon
cards.description: Every hit takes wood out of the other piece and puts it into this one. There is less of this one to begin with.

cards.name: Slipgate
cards.description: Two more jumps out of the board, and the speed carried into one is kept coming out of it.

cards.name: Shock Wave
cards.description: The block, spliced, throws every nearby piece outward.

cards.name: Implode
cards.description: The block, spliced, pulls every nearby piece in.

cards.name: Overpower
cards.description: The block, spliced, punishes whoever stood too close to it.

cards.name: Frost Slam
cards.description: The block, spliced, slows every piece nearby.

cards.name: Tactical Reload
cards.description: The block refills the gun as a side effect.

cards.name: Teleport
cards.description: The block relocates the piece, to wherever it was looking.

cards.name: Bombs Away
cards.description: The block answers with a ring of its own fire.

cards.name: Healing Field
cards.description: The block knits some wood back while it works.

cards.name: Counterstrike
cards.description: A clean block answers in kind, at whoever threw the first shot.

cards.name: Defender
cards.description: The block comes back almost at once, and stays open longer.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.description: Close to stopping, this piece is edited to fight harder instead.

cards.name: Bulwark
cards.description: Slow, heavy, and edited to be hard to take off the board.

cards.name: Thornmail
cards.description: Whatever damages this piece pays for it, at any range.

cards.name: Demonic Pact
cards.description: Fire almost without pause. Every shot costs this piece some wood.

cards.name: Radiance
cards.description: A reload finishes with a burst outward, on its own.

cards.name: Retaliation
cards.description: Whatever hurts this piece is thrown back, wherever it stands.

cards.name: Chilling Presence
cards.description: Every other piece nearby is slowed, for as long as this one stays close.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.description: A stopped piece leaves this one faster, and briefly harder to stop.

cards.name: Swarm
cards.description: Every shot arrives with a ring of its own around it.

cards.name: Event Horizon
cards.description: The block, spliced twice, pulls the board in and crushes it.

cards.name: Graft
cards.description: Spliced. Put the block up and the board answers in kind: a plank stands up in front of you and stays until the round ends.

cards.name: Decoy
cards.description: Spliced. The blink leaves the body where it was, still standing. Shot, it comes apart exactly as the real one would, and the pieces are yours.

cards.name: Rot
cards.description: Spliced. Whatever this piece stops keeps the edit: its pieces carry the poison onward. Moving among them is quicker than standing still.

cards.name: Contagion
cards.description: Spliced. The edit does not stay in one hand. Next round the whole board runs a fever, this piece included.

cards.name: Recall
cards.description: Spliced. The magazine comes back and the shots that missed are told where to go. They were not finished.

cards.name: Cluster
cards.description: Spliced. A shot that meets the board does not stop there. It comes apart, and the pieces keep going.

cards.name: Undertow
cards.description: Spliced. The air around this piece is thicker than the board agreed to. Everything thrown at it arrives late.

cards.name: Displace
cards.description: Spliced. A hit that lands trades the two pieces over. Whatever it was standing on is this one's problem now.

cards.name: Runaway
cards.description: Spliced. Speed is written into the shot. A piece that arrives fast hits like the board threw it.

cards.name: Aftershock
cards.description: Spliced. The place this piece left does not settle quietly.

cards.name: Deadfall
cards.description: Spliced. A hit takes the movement out of a piece entirely. Whatever it was doing in the air, it is doing on the floor.

cards.name: Arrears
cards.description: Spliced. The wound is filed and not felt. It is still owed, and the board collects once the shooting stops.

cards.name: Tithe
cards.description: Spliced. Hurting this piece is taxed. Whatever landed the shot finds its next one already spent.

cards.name: Surfeit
cards.description: Spliced. Stopping a piece returns more wood than this one has room for. The rest is carried on the outside for a while.

cards.name: Backwash
cards.description: Spliced. The block does not stop at one shot. Everything in the air nearby turns around and belongs to this piece now.

cards.name: Standstill
cards.description: Spliced. Leaving costs the board a moment. Everything that was standing near this piece spends it standing still.
